requirements.en: Lead a small bench team and support supervised development of junior staff.
requirements.zh: 领导小型台工团队，并支持初级员工在监督下发展技能。

requirements.en: Fabricate and finish simple silver pieces from approved specifications while tracking materials and piece counts.
requirements.zh: 依据获批规格制作简式银制品并进行表面处理，同时跟踪材料及件数。

requirements.en: Maintain inspection status and controlled handovers without exceeding design or pricing authority.
requirements.zh: 维护检查状态及受控交接，不超越设计或定价权限。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently grade gemstones and certify precious-metal fineness.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立进行宝石分级并认证贵金属成色。
